summary: Deleting-destructor trampoline: re-bases the object pointer back by 4 bytes (a1-4), invokes VtableFixupWithDestructor on that adjusted object, then conditionally frees the object when the a3 flag's low bit is set. Returns the adjusted pointer.

local_names.a1: object pointer shifted forward by 4 (this-adjusted for a derived/base layout)
local_names.a3: allocation-ownership flag; low bit 1 requests free

operations.description: Compute v3 = a1 - 4, re-basing the incoming pointer to the start of the object.
Call VtableFixupWithDestructor(v3, a2, v6, v7, v8) with the adjusted object pointer and forwarded a2 plus three stack locals.
If (a3 & 1) != 0, the object owns its storage and must be freed.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf(v3) to release the object memory.
Return the adjusted object pointer v3.
